name: UI：任务管理-分配明细弹窗内容验证
description: 验证分配明细弹窗内展示审核员分配信息

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '分配明细'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const tables = modal.querySelectorAll('table, .ant-table'); const rows = modal.querySelectorAll('tr, .ant-table-row'); const headers = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('th')).map(th => th.textContent.trim()); const cells = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('td')).map(td => td.textContent.trim()); return { hasModal: true, tableCount: tables.length, rowCount: rows.length, headers, cellSample: cells.slice(0,10) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 弹窗内应展示审核员名称/分配数量等表格数据
